approval_source.question_set: E04 remaining policy questions, first set

decisions.question: D07-Q01
decisions.rule: Mainnet v1 launches with ordinary v2 transfers and staking, ordinary v3 governance, recovery, emergency controls, root-signed upgrades, state sync, the client channel and the local gateway. A contract runtime, bridges, the Airlock, a liquidity bootstrapping pool, wrapped USDC, external oracles, gRPC and treasury spending are POST MAINNET.

decisions.question: D05-Q02
decisions.rule: Genesis issues the whole fixed total of 1,000,000,000 DGT and nothing mints DGT later; the runtime mint path is removed. No DGT is burned. Penalized DGT goes to a penalty escrow until D09 sets its destination. Changing the total needs an upgrade.

decisions.question: D01-Q02
decisions.rule: Every validator derives the epoch observation from committed blocks: utilization is the epoch's transaction bytes, excluding its own observation, over epoch_blocks times max_block_bytes, in parts per million; volatility is 0. CheckTx refuses submitted observations, the proposer inserts the derived one and execution rejects a mismatch. No external oracle is used at launch.

decisions.question: D08-Q02
decisions.rule: Genesis creates a fixed liquid amount of ordinary, transferable DRT, counted in genesis supply, and the genesis manifest assigns it to named accounts such as validator operators and custody accounts.
